glosses: A procedure involving major incisions to remove, repair, or replace a part of a body.

examples.text: Surgery is often necessary to prevent cancer from spreading.

When performed poorly, a labiaplasty — a procedure to reduce the size of the labia minora, and one of the fastest-growing cosmetic surgeries worldwide — can also damage nerves, leading to genital pain and loss of sexual sensation.

glosses: The medical specialty related to the performance of surgical procedures.
A room or department where surgery is performed.

examples.text: The physician's proper place was in the library, not in the surgery.

glosses: A doctor's office; a clinic.

examples.text: I dropped in on the surgery as I was passing to show the doctor my hemorrhoids.

glosses: A medical practitioner’s office hours.

examples.text: Surgery is from six to seven o’clock. If you wanted to bring a dog in, that would be your best time.

glosses: Any arrangement where people arrive and wait for an interview with certain people, particularly a politician. cf. clinic.

examples.text: Our MP will be holding a surgery in the village hall on Tuesday.

glosses: A pre-packaged bankruptcy or \"quick bankruptcy\".
The production of a manifold by removing parts of one manifold and replacing them with corresponding parts of others.
Drastic changes made to anything.

examples.text: The C# compiler evidently performs some major surgery on your code each time you use the await keyword.

glosses: Partie de l’art médical qui consiste à faire avec la main ou à l’aide d’instruments certaines opérations sur le corps de l’homme.

examples.text: Il n’est presque rien de plus grossier, de plus bref que la chirurgie, quand elle se sépare de la médecine, quand celui qui tient le couteau ne sait point que ce couteau est un pis-aller, une défaite de l’ingéniosité thérapeutique. Les femmes sottes admirent cette charcuterie enragée où elles voient un spectacle de force.
Dans les dernières années, la chirurgie de l’épilepsie est apparue comme une solution possible dans le traitement des épilepsies partielles de l'enfant.
La peau tendue par la chirurgie plissait bizarrement.
